title: Jake Hanna's gay drummer routine
summary: Hanna always had a topper, and Herman recalls his funny put-on as an auditioning gay drummer.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: I don't know if I want to characterize it as dry humor, because I don't think that word is proper. But Jake Hanna has always been a person who responded with surprising flavors of his remarks when you say something.

Oh, yeah, he's got a little tapper, a little topper, a little something going at all times. And I think one of the funniest bits that I've ever seen any musician do was when he used to do the gay drummer.
Sure, the guy who auditioned and used to be with (inaudible) the Kenton band and the whole thing. It was a very funny put-on.
Yeah, I haven't thought of that for years. That was marvelous.
Yeah, he did some great [takes.] must ask him
